purpose: Operator decisions on the open-questions register, recorded verbatim
decider: Dinesh (operator), acting under provisional authority per OQ-05
method: Multiple-choice questions put to the operator in the session; the option text below is what was shown; the answer is the option the operator selected

rounds.question: OQ-05 / OQ-11: Who approves the gates and authorised the repository changes?
rounds.answer: I approve everything (Recommended): You (Dinesh) act as Transformation Lead for all roles, provisionally. You also ratify D-009 (the write authorisation) in your own name. CTO review stays recommended.

rounds.question: OQ-01: Which target platform should the design name?
OQ-02 / OQ-03: Which model and network egress may the project use?
rounds.answer: No model, no egress (Recommended): Keep the deterministic provider.

rounds.question: OQ-12 / OQ-16 / OQ-17: Time budget and demo format?
OQ-19: Planted credentials still in git history.
rounds.answer: Keep history, treat as compromised (Recommended). Repo stays private.

rounds.question: OQ-04 / OQ-21: Which regulatory regime applies, and any location-data limits?
OQ-08 / OQ-09: Real business data, and are proxy KPIs acceptable?
OQ-15: REC-0001 collision intent known?
rounds.answer: Don't know: keep treating it as a defect (Recommended)

rounds.question: Ratify OQ-06, OQ-10, OQ-13, OQ-14, OQ-22 as your decisions?

limits: Each answer is the operator's choice among options I offered, in most cases the option I recommended. Options I did not offer were not considered, except through the free-text field that was available.
